items.headline: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027
items.summary: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027 13 October 2026 Joint Committee The Joint Committee of the European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) published today its Annual Work Programme for 2027 , setting out its priorities for addressing cross-sectoral risks and strengthening coordination across the European Union's financial sector.
